Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 24: the slip of [[Hidden Fortress (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on table (only at start of game) with up to three systems from outside your deck face-down under here. If non-[Virtual Block 4] Hidden Base on table: once per game, may deploy a system from here and/or exchange Hidden Base indicator with a system (from parsec 1 to 8) under here. [Immune to Alter]”), word for word the text of [[Hidden Fortress]]. The label under the slip reads “•Rebel Planners (V)”, as printed in the Master List.<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
